# scamp_vm_network_attachment (Resource)

An extra network interface on a VM. The VM's first network is set on the VM itself (primary_network_id); use this resource for every additional network, so one VM can sit in two or more networks at once. Every field forces replacement: the platform attaches and detaches interfaces, it does not move them between networks.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The VM's first network is set on the VM itself. Every additional network is
# an attachment, so one machine can sit in several networks at once.
resource "scamp_vm_network_attachment" "internal" {
  vm_id      = scamp_vm.web.id
  network_id = scamp_network.internal.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network_id` (String) UUID of the network to attach.
- `vm_id` (String) UUID of the VM to attach the network to.

### Optional

- `is_primary` (Boolean) Make this the VM's primary interface. Leave false unless you are deliberately moving the default route.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Interface ID assigned by the platform.
- `ip_internal` (String) Internal IP the platform assigned on this network.
- `mac_address` (String) MAC address of the interface.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Both ids: an interface means nothing without the VM it hangs off.
terraform import scamp_vm_network_attachment.internal 75279184-491e-44cb-af17-838ff438a8f3/c601ade0-bc2d-4f9a-83a6-88a9fa05dadb
```
